title: SARS-CoV-2 Genomic Visualisation
tagline: ML-based dimensionality reduction for viral genomic sequence data
description: Collaborated with Matthew Scicluna (PhD researcher, MILA) to develop a machine learning-based alternative to traditional phylogenetic trees for representing SARS-CoV-2 genomic data. Implemented PCA and t-SNE in Python to produce accurate low-dimensional visualisations of viral sequence relationships — offering a computationally efficient and visually interpretable approach to tracking viral evolution.

title: NITA Client Booking System
tagline: Full-stack appointment platform for Ghana's national IT agency
description: Built a full-stack client booking website during an internship at the National Information Technology Agency (NITA), Ghana. The platform manages client appointment scheduling for IT services. Developed the complete frontend with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and the backend using Node.js — handling routing, form submissions, and data management.
